tldr: Midday batch (Aug 28): A federal judge rules the Pentagon's 'supply chain risk' blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful retaliation over its military-AI red lines — a landmark win for any lab setting its own use limits. All major labs and hyperscalers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle) jointly call for a global AI-powered cyber-defense effort. Hermes Agent ships real-profile browsing — agents act with your actual logins via a managed Chrome profile copy. Qwen3.8-Flash lands on OpenRouter day-1 while Z.ai finally drops the full GLM-5.3 flagship (744B, 200K ctx) on HF after a 2-week cyber-safety delay, and KAIST's K-Fold rivals AlphaFold3 at 25x speed. Plus VGI-Bench pushes video-gen evaluation and Qwen 3.8 27B runs 200K+ context on 16GB VRAM.

articles.title: Judge rules Trump admin's blacklisting of Anthropic was illegal
articles.summary: Judge Rita Lin: the Pentagon's 'supply chain risk' label was unlawful retaliation over Anthropic's red lines on autonomous weapons and mass surveillance — order overturned.

articles.title: Hermes Agent can now browse as you — real-profile browsing
articles.summary: Agent acts with your logins from a managed copy of your existing Chrome profile — agentic web tasks stop breaking on auth walls.

articles.title: OpenAI + Anthropic + hyperscalers call for global AI cyber-defense
articles.summary: Joint call with AWS, Google, Microsoft and Oracle: a limited window exists to give defenders the tools, resources and support to protect critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-Flash is live on OpenRouter day-1
articles.summary: Coding assistants, agentic workflows and long-video understanding one API call away through every agent framework that routes via OpenRouter.

articles.title: GLM-5.3 flagship open weights drop after cyber-safety delay
articles.summary: Z.ai releases full GLM-5.3 (744B total / ~40B active, 200K ctx) on HF — held back 2 weeks after post-training produced exploit chains; independent verification starts now.

articles.title: KAIST unveils K-Fold — AlphaFold3-class bio AI, 25x faster
articles.summary: Korea's sovereign protein-drug binding model: ~1-min predictions vs AlphaFold3's ~30 min, +33% more accurate on PROTAC design, live on HyperLab.

articles.title: VGI-Bench — probing visual intelligence in video generation models
articles.summary: New benchmark evaluating how much video-gen models actually understand — the eval frontier moves to video understanding.

articles.title: Qwen 3.8 27B runs 200K+ context on 16GB VRAM
articles.summary: UD-IQ3_XXS quant holds quality with very few erroneous tool calls; prompt processing drops from 700-800 to ~400 tk/s.
